newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FT Holdings ends debut below issue price.
newsitem.headline: FT Holdings ends debut below issue price.

text.p: Shares of artificial Christmas tree maker FT Holdings International Ltd ended their trading debut on Friday at HK$0.89 each, below their issue price of HK$1.00 per share.
Brokers said stop-loss selling emerged as the shares dived below the issue price, further depressing the price.
The shares moved in a range of HK$0.88 to HK$1.02 per share on volume of 6.57 million shares worth HK$5.94 million.

"The absence of a concept -- such as red-chip or China-related -- behind the share, or of strong fundamentals such as high earnings growth, made the counter unattractive among investors," said a sales manager at local brokerage.
Brokers said they expected follow-through stop-loss selling to pressure the shares' price in the short run.

FT Holdings engages in the design, manufacture and sales of artificial plants for decorative purposes, specialising in Christmas trees. It offered 57.5 million shares at HK$1.00 per share and was about 7.48 times subscribed.

FT Holdings said it would use the proceeds to set up a floral products manufacturing joint venture in northern China, to expand production facilities in its manufacturing plant in Dongguan, in Guangdong province, and for working capital.
